biggest_catch: The $50 is a savings boost for planned college savings — and it requires you to save $150 of your own money ($25/month for six months) to unlock it. The promotion ends 12/31/2026 and is only for babies under one year old.
catches: To get the $50 you must open the account before your baby's first birthday AND set up recurring contributions of at least $25/month for six months — that's $150 of your own money saved to earn the $50 bonus.
You MUST use the 2026 promo code 'SmartStart26' when opening the account, or the bonus won't attach.
Promotion ends 12/31/2026 — a hard deadline; after that the offer is gone unless renewed.
Only for babies under a year old; minimum $50 opening deposit.
Standard 529 tax risk: non-qualified withdrawals face federal income tax plus a 10% federal penalty on earnings (and possible state tax consequences) — consult a tax professional.
See the official rules for full details — the fetched page summarizes; exact match crediting timing and forfeiture terms live in the official rules PDF.
